title: Frontend adapter in mechdsl-core
objective: Expose parse(latex_str) function that normalizes NRPyLaTeX fork output into a stable project context schema.

plan_assets.asset_description: Example LaTeX input with mechanics directives

implementation_steps: Implement parse(latex_str) -> dict that calls NRPyLaTeX fork
Normalize fork output into stable project context schema
Add input validation and clear error messages for malformed directives
Write integration tests confirming stable dict schema
acceptance_criteria: parse() returns stable dict schema for MVP LaTeX snippet
Malformed directives produce clear error messages
Schema includes: dim, coordinates, material, formulation, cell, boundaries

cases: MVP snippet produces correct dict schema
Missing dim directive raises clear error
Invalid cell type raises clear error

risks: Schema changes in fork output may break adapter — pin fork to specific commit
